description:
I’m James Walker.

This channel is about the warning signs firefighters notice before a house fire starts.

Electrical hazards. Kitchen fires. Dryers. Space heaters. Smoke alarms. Batteries. Garages. Older homes. Everyday habits that seem harmless until they aren’t.

No panic. Just practical home-fire prevention in plain English.

James Walker is a fictional educational host presenting researched household fire-safety information.
